title: Bechet's Lincoln with hidden weapons
summary: In France the second time, Bechet showed off his new Lincoln, which hid a rifle over the windshield, a carbine, a .45 under the dash and more.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
